x_posts._note: X 动态由 Claude 在你要求时手动读取(见 README),结果存到 data/x/YYYY-MM-DD.json;下列是固定的搜索条件

queries._note: {since} 换成 7 天前的日期(YYYY-MM-DD),否则热门排序会混进几个月前的旧帖;一组滚动 4 到 5 次约可读 6 到 10 则
queries.model: ("new model" OR "we are releasing" OR "now available" OR benchmark OR "open-source model") (LLM OR model) min_faves:700 lang:en since:{since} -filter:replies
queries.agentic: (agentic OR "AI agents" OR "coding agent" OR MCP) min_faves:500 lang:en since:{since} -filter:replies
queries.physical_ai: ("physical AI" OR humanoid OR robotics OR "world model" OR VLA) min_faves:300 lang:en since:{since} -filter:replies
